{{Documentation subpage}}

This template shows square miles only.

Conversion to square miles via {{tlx|cvt}} or {{tlx|convert}} is strongly suggested by [[WP:UNITS]]. Eg:
* <code><nowiki>{{cvt|100|mi2|0}}</nowiki></code> → {{cvt|100|mi2|0}}
* <code><nowiki>{{cvt|100|mi2|round=5}}</nowiki></code> → {{cvt|100|mi2|round=5}}

== Usage ==
{{tlxi|mi2|number}}

Example:
* {{tld|mi2}} → {{mi2}}
* {{tld|mi2|123.45}} → {{mi2|123.45}}
* {{tld|mi2|123.45 million}} → {{mi2|123.45 million}}
* {{tld|mi2|123.45|3=link=yes}} → {{mi2|123.45|link=yes}}
